name: Canvas Grid
description: Canvas grid pattern generation utility. Renders dot or grid patterns to a canvas element and exposes data URL for CSS background-image. Resolves CSS --tertiary variable for color. applyGridToElement sets background-image, repeat, size, and position to create an infinite panning grid. Supports three styles: none, dots (2px radius circles), grid (1px L-shaped lines).

functions.name: generateGridPattern
functions.description: Generate canvas data URL for dots or grid pattern

functions.name: applyGridToElement
functions.signature: (el: HTMLElement, style: GridStyle, dataURL: string, patternSize: number, scale: number, panX: number, panY: number) => void
functions.description: Apply grid background to element with transform-aware position/size
